title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #081 · 매체 믹스 · 대각 띠·매끈 · 5영역(사이아노타입+수채+이레즈미+팝아트 코믹+맨살) · 부분 맨살 · glamour hourglass · 정면 한 손 허리 · Middle Eastern · 배경 검정 스튜디오 · 글래스 스킨
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 20s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long straight balayage hair — her body is painted in 4 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 diagonal bands by 4 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 14% of the way down her figure from the top, about 41% of the way down her figure from the top, about 58% of the way down her figure from the top and about 75% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries deep Prussian-blue cyanotype prints with white fern and leaf silhouettes. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries translucent watercolour washes in rose and cerulean with pooled edges and thin downward drips. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo art in bold black ink outlines with indigo, crimson and white waves, clouds and peonies flowing over her curves. Region 4 is the diagonal band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries pop-art comic panels with bold black outlines, flat red, yellow and blue shapes and big speech bursts. Region 5 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it stays her own bare living skin with a natural satin sheen. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin, and the last region left as natural bare skin. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, one hand resting on her waist and the other hand relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-bright glass skin dripping with wet liquid shine, blinding liquid highlighter across the cheekbones, nose bridge, forehead and chin, a flushed dewy blush, mirror-gloss lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows tanning oil sheen, golden bronzed glistening skin.

Background: a pure black studio void with soft key light shaping her body, nothing else in frame. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
